About Masaar

Not Just a Villa —
A Complete Life Among the Trees

Masaar by Arada is a fully gated community in Sharjah, home to more than 4,000 villas and townhouses spread across eight private districts. Surrounded by over 100,000 trees, Masaar carries the identity of a true forest within the city.

Every home comes equipped with smart-home technology, premium finishes, and direct access to parks and green corridors — a rare balance between sustainability, luxury, and family living.

Amenities & Services

Everything Your Family Needs, Just Steps Away

Central Lagoon & Waterfalls

The heart of the community — a resort-style pool with landscaped waterfalls, gym, and café to unwind.

Jogging & Cycling Tracks

13 kilometers of shaded tracks dedicated to jogging and cycling across the community.

Sports Courts

Courts for football, tennis, basketball, and padel — for every age and interest.

Parks & Family Areas

Adventure playgrounds, a duck pond, and community parks encouraging outdoor family living.

Masaar Souq & Retail Walk

Retail outlets, restaurants, and cafés, plus the Zad food-truck park for casual dining.

Fully Smart Homes

Smart-home technology, energy-efficient appliances, and fully fitted kitchens — ready for move-in.

About the Developer — Arada

Arada is one of the UAE's leading real estate developers, founded in 2017 and based in Sharjah, known for sustainable, design-led communities that connect people with nature. With Masaar, Arada redefines modern living through a tranquil, forest-inspired community that blends wellness, sustainability, and contemporary design — alongside other landmark projects such as Aljada and Nest.

Location

In the Heart of Sharjah, Close to Everything

Masaar Discovery Centre

Masaar Discovery Centre, Al Suyoh, Sharjah — minutes from Masaar 2, Sharjah Mosque, Khaled Bin Sultan City, Tilal City, and Nasma Residences. Direct access to Khorfakkan Road with quick links to Emirates Road (E611) towards Dubai.
